_comment: IndexTTS-2 via TTS-Audio-Suite. This replaces the Chatterbox + rubberband approach: characters are cast by picking a distinct REFERENCE VOICE on node 30 (narrator_voice) and directed by setting emotion weights on node 20. No pitch shifting - shifting one voice pack +/-30% is what made the earlier films sound like one actor on a varispeed tape.
_notes: Node 30 narrator_voice: use only the GENERIC samples (higgs_audio/*, male/*, female/*). Do NOT use the Clint_Eastwood / David_Attenborough / Morgan_Freeman / Sophie_Anderson samples that ship with the pack - those are clones of real identifiable people.
Node 20 emotion weights are 0.0-1.0 each: Happy Angry Sad Surprised Afraid Disgusted Calm Melancholic. emotion_alpha on node 10 scales the whole emotion vector.
repetition_penalty defaults to 10.0, which is high; lower it toward 2-4 if delivery sounds clipped or words get dropped.
Weights auto-download to models/TTS on first run.
